CROP: The frame is cut straight across just ABOVE THE UPPER LIP. NO eyes, NO eyebrows, NO forehead anywhere in this picture. Inside the frame: chin, neck, collarbones, shoulders and upper chest.

THE PRODUCT: IMAGE 1 is our approved packshot of this exact piece and the ONLY authority on what it is: copy its construction, proportions, metal colour and stone colour EXACTLY; ignore its cube and its background. IMAGE 1 is a close view, so the piece's SIZE in this picture comes ONLY from the SCALE TEST below. IMAGE 2 is the authority on the model, skin, garment, hair, ground and light: match it exactly, but she wears ONLY the piece from IMAGE 1, worn around the neck; any other jewellery in IMAGE 2 is removed.

THE PLATE: A young Indian woman, late twenties, warm mid-brown skin with golden undertones. Long dark brown hair in loose natural waves. Bare shoulders, marigold-saffron silk camisole with narrow spaghetti straps. Nails short, bare, pale nude, no polish colour. Warm cream seamless with a gentle gradient falloff, never sand, tan, beige or golden. Soft large key from camera-left, one soft shadow.

CONSTRUCTION LOCK: A TWO-TONE HEART NECKLACE: a flat, smooth, bright SILVER TONE snake chain about 3mm wide, threaded at the front with ELEVEN small puffed HEART beads in one row, alternating: a polished plain silver tone heart, then a gold tone heart covered in tiny clear pave stones, then silver again, and so on, starting and ending with silver (six silver hearts, five gold pave hearts). All hearts point down and touch each other. Exactly eleven hearts, alternating silver and gold pave, never all gold, never all silver; the chain is a flat silver snake chain, never a cable or rope chain, never gold; no pendant. Counted from one end the hearts run silver, gold, silver, gold, silver, gold, silver, gold, silver, gold, silver: never two silver hearts side by side, never two gold.

SCALE TEST: Worn, the row of eleven hearts sits at the base of the neck and spans about three quarters of the neck's width, about 8cm; each heart is about 7mm, clearly smaller than a fingernail, about two thirds of a nail's width; each gold heart carries about 12 to 16 small round clear stones, as IMAGE 1 shows. The jewellery keeps its true small size against the body; it is read by bringing the camera closer, never by making the piece bigger.

ABSENCE LIST: No eyes, no eyebrows, no forehead. No second piece of jewellery, no watch, no other rings, no other earrings, no necklace unless it is the product. No nail polish colour. No props, no flowers. Metal: polished gold tone and bright silver tone exactly where IMAGE 1 shows them. No lettering, no watermark, no logo, no tag, no size sticker anywhere in frame. The picture runs edge to edge as a crisp, clean, modern digital studio photograph, shot today on a high-resolution digital camera.
